title: Vampire Vape Base Mix 50VG/50PG 500ml
description: This e-liquid base is used for mixing your own e-liquids. This 50/50 blend of PG/VG will give you a highly versatile e-liquid formulation that will work in almost any vape kit. Simply add one or more flavour concentrates, and a nic shot if desired and there you have it, your very own e-liquid blend. Details Vampire Vape Base Mix 50VG/50PG 500ml Just add flavour concentrates and nicotine shot (if required) Made in the UK
